column1: # billing-read-actions.tsv: every action in the billing policy of setup/iam/aws-ai-access-2026-10-07.sh
# (policy otchealth-ai-reader-billing, statement CostAndBillingReadOnly). One action per line: action|access level|page
# access level: the "Access level" column of the AWS Service Authorization Reference. Only Read and List are allowed here.
# page: the reference page of the service, at https://docs.aws.amazon.com/service-authorization/latest/reference/<page>
# (billing:GetBillingData, GetBillingDetails, GetBillingNotifications, GetBillingViewData and consolidatedbilling:* are in the
# "Permission-only actions" table of their page: they exist for the Billing console.)
# policy-audit.py (run by the owner-script tests) fails when the saved policy and this list differ, or a level is not Read or List.
